messages.author: 6d92cf5715194cf9
messages.subject: Mac Installation error of package "rhbase"
parts:
Hey guys,

I am new to this topic and I really want to try the RHadoop.

By searching the Internet, I notice that we can actually install RHadoop for Mac OS (my case is 10.6.8.)

So far, I have successfully installed the package rmr2 (i.e., rmr2_2.2.1.tar) and rhdfs (i.e., rhdfs_1.0.6.tar). However, I have been struggled to get the rhbase (i.e.rhbase_1.2.0.tar) to work.

First I install the thrift using terminal: brew install thrift

Then I use the following command in terminal to install the package:
R CMD INSTALL /Users/mac/Desktop/rhbase_1.2.0.tar

However, I kept on get the following error (the actual error message is very long, here I just present the first few rows):

WARNING: ignoring environment value of R_HOME
* installing to library ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library’
* installing *source* package ‘rhbase’ ...
** libs
llvm-g++-4.2 -arch x86_64 -I/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/include -DNDEBUG  -I/usr/local/include   -I. -g  -DHAVE_UINTPTR_T -DHAVE_NETDB_H=1 -fpermissive -DHAVE_INTTYPES_H -DHAVE_NETINET_IN_H -I./gen_cpp `pkg-config --cflags thrift` -Wall -fPIC  -mtune=core2 -g -O2  -c Hbase.cpp -o Hbase.o
/bin/sh: pkg-config: command not found
In file included from Hbase.cpp:7:
Hbase.h:10:24: error: TProcessor.h: No such file or directory
In file included from Hbase.h:11,
                 from Hbase.cpp:7:
Hbase_types.h:10:20: error: Thrift.h: No such file or directory
Hbase_types.h:11:35: error: TApplicationException.h: No such file or directory
Hbase_types.h:12:32: error: protocol/TProtocol.h: No such file or directory
Hbase_types.h:13:34: error: transport/TTransport.h: No such file or directory
In file included from Hbase.h:11,
                 from Hbase.cpp:7:
Hbase_types.h:19: error: ‘string’ in namespace ‘std’ does not name a type
Hbase_types.h:21: error: ‘string’ in namespace ‘std’ does not name a type

I am guessing I must have missed something, maybe the setup for hbase? Any help will be appreciated.

Thanks in advance for any kind help.





Best wishes,
Fan
